If your mind has learned the equation: 
> *My value = my output / my utility*

Then the moment output drops to zero, your perceived value drops to zero.

When you force a high-functioning defense mechanism to stop cold turkey, the nervous system panics. You don't feel restored; you feel anxious, guilty, listless, and profoundly low.
